online_learning: per-convoy sender agreement from local observations; reset every episode
spoof_contract: 60% false clear on adversary-known interdictions, 40% false block on other edges; 25% identity impersonation in heavy/reactive regimes
clearance_guard: two fresh claimed independent clear sources or direct local observation; preserved warning anchors expire at TTL
scope: original 19-node topology plus ten new graphs each at 39 and 51 nodes; declared mixed sensor coverage
limitations: Approximate probabilities and sender agreement are not calibrated
No authenticated identity; multiple forged identities can invalidate clearance quorum
No learned deep gate; adaptive method is model-based routing and admission
Soft-fusion comparators isolate estimator changes from filtering
No general superiority or convergence assumed
